text:
Aisha: quick check — who currently owns the S3/GS path ingesting audit logs that were re-encrypted with the new KMS key? Need to produce an evidence snapshot for ISO fieldwork in ~2 weeks. Found ~3 objects missing rotation metadata :confused:

Ben: eng-infra owns the bucket, but KMS key ownership lives with infra-crypto. Which prefix are you looking at?

Aisha: /audit/keystore/ is where the ingest lands. Example: `s3://redwood-audit/audit/keystore/2026-03-14/xxxxx.json` — some objects don't have `x-amz-meta-rotation` and our auditflow tool flags them.

Raj: yep that's under eng-infra but crypto should confirm tagging rules. @Maria can you confirm the key rotation policy applied during migration? :eyes:

Maria: We switched the envelope key last month and the migration job should have populated `rotation=2026-02-28` metadata. I'll grep the migration logs. Offhand: there was one retry window where the lambda timed out.

Ben: can you paste the CLI to list the failing objects? I'll run a quick sweep.

Aisha: sure — `aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-audit --prefix audit/keystore/2026-03-14 --query "Contents[?contains(Key, 'xxxxx')].Key"` — then `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-audit --key <key> --query Metadata`

Maria: running migration logs now. If the lambda timed out some objects may have been copied without metadata. We should either backfill metadata or mark them in the evidence pack with a compensating control.

Raj: ops-oncall, can you confirm whether we have a replayable task to reapply metadata? If not, we should create one and schedule a low-risk window.

ops-oncall: we can run a backfill job that reads objects and writes tag/metadata — low IO. Will open a small playbook and CI job. ETA to prototype: EOD tomorrow.

Ben: thumbs up. Once ops-oncall has the job, can we add a short-runbook step to capture outputs (count, sha256 list) into the evidence bucket so auditors can verify? :thumbsup:

Aisha: yes please — auditors want an immutable manifest and the job's invocation logs. Also need KMS key ID used for each file. If backfill changes objects, we should ensure we preserve original timestamps/hashes or produce a signed statement.

Maria: good call. I'll extract the KMS key IDs from the migration logs and attach to the evidence doc.

security-bot: created ticket RED-ISO-2145 and attached initial findings (3 objects missing metadata).

Aisha: thanks. Owners: Ben (bucket ownership), Raj (crypto verification), ops-oncall (backfill playbook), Maria (migration logs + KMS key IDs). Can each owner drop a short note in this thread when done?

Ben: noted. I'll run a bucket sweep now and post counts.

Raj: I'll validate rotation policy and confirm whether HSM attestation windows were respected during migration.

ops-oncall: creating prototype job now, will post PR link when ready.

Maria: logs in progress — will paste snippets if anything odd pops up.

Aisha: perfect. If anyone hits blockers that affect the ISO timeline, ping me ASAP and we'll escalate. :pray:
